payload.core_mechanism_summary: Custom sorting of teams by points, goal difference, goals scored, then name; brute-force enumeration of possible scorelines.
payload.rationale: The solution defines a get_sort function that sorts teams with a custom comparator (points desc, goal diff desc, goals desc, name asc) using swaps to correct lexicographical order. The search loops over X and Y from 0 to 49, which is simple enumeration.
